title: Harvey’s Partnership with ElevenLabs
format_note: 23 s single-shot motion graphic: logo lockup, voice waveform, rotating globe, two stat titles, logo lockup. No product UI, no cuts.
one_thing: Harvey and ElevenLabs partner so law has a global voice: 7000 voices across 32 languages.

transcript.voice_style: Slow, single narrator; three spoken lines across 21 s. Inferred from whisper timing and a speech tag of 0.743, not heard.
transcript.script_shape: Announcement line, then the two numbers, then a two-word sign-off. On-screen captions add two lines whisper did not transcribe (t=8 s and t=12 s).

structure.frame0: Dark ground, centred Harvey (serif) / ElevenLabs (bold sans) lockup, nothing else. Subject is the partnership itself (f0001.jpg).
structure.first_3s: Lockup holds until about 2.25 s, tightens and widens at 0.67-0.96 s, then gives way to a particle waveform and the caption at 2.29 s (strips/window-02-2.125s.jpg).

beats.what: Harvey / ElevenLabs lockup centred on near-black, spacing animates at 0.67-0.96 s.
Particle waveform breathes while caption reads 'Harvey and ElevenLabs now partner to give law a global voice'.
Waveform collapses into a dotted globe; flag chips English, Spanish, Japanese appear on glowing voice points; captions on legal access.
'7000 Voices' enters left of the globe, 'Supporting 7000 voices across 32 languages' caption below.
'32 Languages' enters right; the globe is flanked by both numbers, the fullest frame (f0009.jpg).
Globe and titles dissolve into the waveform; caption 'Heard worldwide'.
Lockup returns, tight then widened, holds to the end.

hero_moment.what: Globe flanked by '7000 Voices' and '32 Languages' at once (f0009.jpg); the only frame with both facts.

ending.what: Harvey / ElevenLabs lockup on the dark ground, no tagline or URL (f0011.jpg, f0012.jpg).

rhythm.how_change_is_paced: One unbroken shot. Visuals change by morphing particles (wave to globe at 5 s, globe to wave at 17.8 s) and by captions swapping every 2-4 s. 90.9 % of sampled intervals are static (metrics frames.intervals_static_share).

look.ground: Flat near-black with a faint warm green cast (mean luminance 0.062), no gradient or texture; 100 % of sampled frames dark (dark_share 1.0).
palette: soft white glow on voice points
look.accent_use: No accent colour. The only colour is the 3 flag chips (UK, Spain, Japan), each about 30 px wide, visible 1-3 s.
look.type: Serif for Harvey wordmark and the two stat titles; neutral sans for captions and flag labels; bold grotesque for the ElevenLabs wordmark. All white.

title_measurements.text: Harvey and ElevenLabs now partner to give law a global voice

look.depth: Glow on voice points and a soft halo around the globe; flat otherwise. Globe rotates, giving parallax-like depth on a flat ground.

product_ui.camera_on_ui: No product UI and no camera move; the globe rotates in place at a fixed size of about 320 px (44 % of frame height).
product_ui.notes: Captions are 3.6 % of height and read at phone width; flag labels such as 'English' are about 15 px tall (2 %) and would not read on a phone (crops/flag.png).

motion.text_entry: Stat titles slide in from the sides over about 0.4 s (strips/window-09-13.584s.jpg frames 10-12, window-10 frames 1-3); captions swap in place with a short gap.
motion.ui_motion: Flag chips attach to a glowing voice point, hold, and shrink away at 10.6-10.7 s; points drift and re-cluster as the globe turns.
motion.camera: Static. No push, pan or zoom.
motion.eases: Not measured numerically; waveform and chip motion look smooth and damped in the strips.

transitions.cause: Waveform particles collapse into the globe; at 17.8 s the globe disperses back into the waveform.
Lockup disappears and waveform plus caption appear within 0.04 s; at 20.8 s waveform fades to lockup.
Caption and flag chip change as the voice point changes.

copy.holds_vs_reading_rule: Holds are read from strips, accurate to about 0.2 s. The 11-word opener (3.5 s vs 3.8 s required) and the 8-word line at 11.04 s (2.5 s vs 2.9 s) fall short; the rest pass.

sound.music: Kind 'music' with speech over it. Tags: keyboard_musical 0.362, organ 0.228, synthesizer 0.202. No steady beat (confidence 0.037), one section A, so a soft pad-like bed at most.
sound.sfx: None established; no describe tag points to effects.
sound.vo_music_balance: Speech tag 0.743 against music 0.668: voice and bed close in level. Integrated -13.5 LUFS, true peak -1.2 dBTP, LRA 4.8 LU.
sound.energy_arc: Flat: loudness range 4.8 LU, short-term max -11.3 LUFS, silence only in the first 0.34 s and last 0.6 s.
sound.sync_to_picture: No cuts exist, so cut-to-sound alignment cannot be measured. Whisper puts speech at 0-7 s, 7-18 s and 18-21 s, loosely matching the caption changes at 2.3 s, 14 s and 18.6 s.

good.observation: One visual idea (a particle waveform that becomes a globe and back) carries the whole message, so the film needs no cuts and stays calm.
The two proof numbers are set large in serif on either side of the globe, so the hero frame is also the fact frame.
Brand lockup is the first and last frame, with the same tight-to-wide spacing move both times, so the film is bookended.
Captions sit at one fixed bottom position at 3.6 % of height, so the eye never searches for the line.
good.evidence: f0002.jpg, f0005.jpg, f0010.jpg; ink 26 px at t=2.8 s

good.observation: Loudness meets the social target: -13.5 LUFS, true peak -1.2 dBTP.

weak.observation: Roughly 91 % of intervals are static and the frame is mostly empty ground; on a feed this reads slow, and the hook at 0-2 s is only a lockup.
Flag chips are small (about 15 px label text) and vanish within 1-3 s, so the language idea is hard to read at phone width.
Two captions are not in the spoken track, and '7000' loses its thousands comma on screen (whisper wrote '7,000').

rule_candidates.rule: A partnership sting may open on the two-brand lockup alone if it re-animates within 1 s (spacing change at 0.67-0.96 s) and the subject of the film is the pairing.
A 23 s sting can run as one continuous shot with 0 hard cuts if change comes from a morphing hero object and caption swaps every 2-4 s.
Put each proof number in its own title (5.8-7.2 % of frame height, two words) beside the hero, so the hero frame carries every fact.
rule_candidates.evidence: ink 42 px and 52 px of 720; f0009.jpg

rule_candidates.rule: Keep running captions at a fixed bottom position and about 3.6 % of height (26 px of 720); hold the last caption at least 2 s.
rule_candidates.evidence: ink at t=2.8 s; 'Heard worldwide' 18.58-20.8 s

rule_candidates.rule: Allow a dark minimal frame to leave over a quarter of the frame empty when the single hero object stays centred and at least 40 % tall; here the globe is about 44 % tall.
Close on the opening lockup for at least 2.5 s with the same spacing animation, so start and end match.
When the product is sound or voice, visualise it as a particle waveform that opens and closes the film around the concept visual; no product UI is needed.
Master at -13.5 LUFS with true peak of -1.2 dBTP for social, as here.
